board.title: Requests — businesses looking for space
board.subtitle: Businesses post what kind of space they need. Owners and brokers contact them directly.
board.metaTitle: Request board — who's looking for commercial space
board.metaDescription: Cafes, shops, offices and warehouses looking for space right now in Tbilisi and the regions. Respond and offer your space.
board.emptyHint: Change the filters or add your own request — owners will find you.
board.ctaTitle: Looking for a space? Let owners find you
board.ctaLead: Describe the space you need — area, budget, districts. Matching offers arrive straight in your messages.

detail.matchesHint: Active spaces that match the business type, area, budget and district.
detail.matchesEmpty: No matching spaces right now. You'll be notified when a new space is published.
detail.inactive: This request isn't active — responses are disabled.

contact.title: Respond
contact.hint: Your message will go to the request's author. You'll see the reply in the messages section.
contact.bodyPlaceholder: e.g. I have an 80 m² space with a shop window in Vake, you can view it tomorrow.

form.title: Add a request
form.subtitle: Describe the space you need. Owners and brokers will offer suitable options.
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Cafe, 60–90 m² in Vake, with a shop window
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Term, technical requirements, when you need it
form.budgetHint: For rent — monthly; for purchase — total amount.
form.phoneHint: Visible only to you. Contact with the author is via messages.
form.error: Couldn't save the request. Check the fields.
form.tip1: Give an area range and a budget — offers will be far more precise.
form.tip2: Tick several districts if your location is flexible.
form.tip3: Your number is only shown when you reply yourself.

account.title: My requests
account.empty: You don't have any requests yet
account.emptyHint: Post what kind of space you need — owners will contact you.
